{{:Century Cakes/Countdown}} {{LiveCountdownBox|routine=A[Y600] C[5d 4h -U] L[1]|title=[[File:Complete Century Cake Bundle.png|30px|link=]] Year 600 Raffle of the Century}} {{Infobox/Generic |image=Complete Century Cake Bundle.png |label1=Category|data1=Event}} The '''Raffle of the Century''' is an [[Event]] that happens every {{Green|100}} [[SkyBlock Year]]s. == Mechanics == The '''Raffle of the Century''' has {{Green|3}} tiers of raffles known as the {{Raffle|Speed}}, {{Raffle|Daily}} and {{Raffle|Big One}}. The {{Raffle|Speed}} rolls every {{Green|2}} hours, the {{Raffle|Daily}} every {{Green|24}} hours, and {{Raffle|Big One}} at the end of the event. In order to participate in the '''Raffle of the Century''', the player must speak to {{NPCSprite|Rezzus}} in the {{Zone|Village}} to be assigned to one of the following teams: {{Mctxt|9|BLUE|bold=true}}, {{Mctxt|e|YELLOW|bold=true}}, {{Mctxt|a|GREEN|bold=true}}, {{Mctxt|c|RED|bold=true}} or {{Mctxt|d|PINK|bold=true}}. Upon joining a team, the player gains {{Aqua|3 Raffle Tickets}} and a corresponding team [[Emblem]] is applied for the remainder of the event and cannot be removed. After a player is assigned to a team, they can then either speak to the {{NPCSprite|Incredible Raffle Box}}, open the {{NPCSprite|Incredible Raffle Box}} in the [[SkyBlock Menu]], or use {{Code|/century}} or {{Code|/centuryrafflebox}} to see all the rewards, tasks, and current raffles. == Earning Tickets == To enter a raffle, the player must earn {{Aqua|Raffle Tickets}}. {{Aqua|Raffle Tickets}} can be earned through various methods. === Being Online === The player earns {{Green|1}} {{Aqua|Raffle Ticket}} for every {{Green|15}} minutes of being online, totaling {{Green|96}} {{Aqua|Raffle Tickets}} per day. === Raffle Tasks === Every {{Green|2}} hours, players receive an identical list of {{Green|21}} total tasks, with {{Green|7}} of each (easy, medium and hard) difficulty.
